verdict.rationale: Hatchet is an orchestration platform rather than an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. Its first-party 'Hatchet Agent Tools' cookbook (URL slug hatchet-and-mcp) documents exposing workflows and tasks as tools that agent frameworks like the Claude Agent SDK and OpenAI Agents SDK can invoke. However, the evidence never describes a shipped, official MCP server endpoint or package, and this page may be a pattern for developers rather than a product feature. missing for 10: explicit official MCP server (hosted endpoint or installable package), setup and connection docs for MCP clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
